senses.gloss: m. (v. חֶרֶשׁ; cmp. לַחַשׁ) fascinator, charmer, sorcerer.
units: <cite ref="Onkelos Deuteronomy 18:10">Targ. O. Deut. XVIII, 10</cite> (some ed. <cite ref="H01777"><he>חֲרָשׁ</he></cite>); a. e.—
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 3:6:3">Cant. R. to III, 6</cite>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Chagigah 2:2:6">Y. Ḥag. II, 77ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>עיסקיה דהדין ח׳ וכ׳</he> it is the nature of a sorcerer that he can do nothing when lifted from the ground.

<cite ref="Berakhot 62a:22">Ber. 62ᵃ</cite> bot. (in an incantation) <he>לא חַרְשֵׁי דח׳ וכ׳</he> (Var. <he>דחָרָשֵׁי …</he> pl., v. Rabb. D. S. a. l, note 8) no charm of a sorcerer or of a sorceress.—Pl. <cite ref="H01789"><he>חָרָשִׁין</he></cite>, <he>חָרָשַׁיָּא</he>, <he>חָרָשֵׁי</he>, <cite ref="H00475"><he>חֲרָ׳</he></cite>. Targ. Y. Deut. l. c. (ed. Amst. <cite ref="H01789"><he>חַרְשִׁין</he></cite>).
Targ. Ps. LVIII, 6; a. e.—Y. Ḥag. l. c.; Y. Snh. VI, 23ᶜ bot.—Fem. חָרָשָׁא חֲרַשְׁתָּא,.
<cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 22:17">Targ. O. Ex. XXII, 17</cite>.—Ber. l. c. (Var. <cite ref="H01790"><he>חַרְשִׁיתָא</he></cite>).—V. <cite ref="H01789"><he>חַרְשִׁין</he></cite>.
